descriptors.name: beat_this_compare
descriptors.title: Experimental learned beat/downbeat comparison (Beat This final0)
descriptors.description: Compare CPJKU Beat This final0 beat and downbeat hypotheses with the project click grid on a current hash-bound denoised run. Uses only a registry-verified local checkpoint and the qualified isolated Linux CPU runtime; never downloads or installs. Writes a fresh comparison beneath artifacts/s2/model_lanes, reports the half/double relation to the click grid, and leaves meter, intended tempo and real-take accuracy unknown.
descriptors.intent: Give agents and musicians a second, independent pulse estimate for half-time, odd-grouping, drift and legato passages of the distorted nine-string without adopting it as a detector, meter or tempo authority.

run_dir.description: Existing run beneath repository artifacts/runs with regular manifest.json (<=1 MiB) and manifest-verified denoised.wav (<=300 s). Traversal/symlink components are rejected.

timeout_seconds.description: Outer owned-process deadline; the worker's own inference deadline is 600 s.

limitations: Fixed final0 checkpoint, CPU, float16 off, DBN off, upstream minimal postprocessing; no tunable knobs. Typed refusals in order: model_not_registered, model_hash_not_registered, model_registry_entry_invalid, model_file_missing, model_hash_mismatch, runtime_not_qualified, platform_unsupported (Linux only), input_rejected.
Beats from a mono mixture with an in-room click are model hypotheses; downbeats are not bar lines; meter_claim is always none and time_signature null.
half_double_ratio_vs_click_grid is arithmetic on outputs against rhythm.analyze defaults, not an intended-tempo identification.
F-measure at 70 ms exists only for generated fixtures; real-take accuracy, note correctness and performance issues are never reported.
Upstream mel front end starts at 30 Hz on a 22.05 kHz analysis downmix; masters are untouched and ~32 Hz handling is not implied.

dependencies.note: Requires root's hash-bound cpjku-beat-this-final0 registry entry and prefetch plus beat-this-runtime-setup on honey (flake ml shell). Prior tools are not invoked automatically.

agent_workflow.identify: Inspect beat/downbeat counts, median IBI, half/double relation, model/runtime/input hashes and the fixed unknown fields.
agent_workflow.research: Read docs/research/BEAT_THIS_QUALIFICATION.md and the preregistered s3-beat-1 protocol before interpreting disagreements.
agent_workflow.iterate: Compare against rhythm/bpm evidence per passage and listen to disagreements; any setting change is a new preregistered experiment with new seeds.
agent_workflow.acceptance: Successful inference or agreement with the click grid does not establish meter, intended tempo, real-take beat accuracy, listening or default adoption.

descriptors.name: guitar_noul_decide
descriptors.title: Experimental guitar_noul gateway window hypotheses (TIN-5619)
descriptors.description: Send bounded source-timed windows of a verified run to the configured tailnet-only models.xoxd.ai guitar_noul gateway and record per-window detector hypotheses (opaque label or abstain) with model identity. Refuses when the gateway is unset; sends real-take windows only with the explicit V6 operator switch; never writes inside the run.
descriptors.intent: Collect an external detector's per-window hypotheses for comparison with project phrase/rhythm evidence without turning them into labels, flags or note verdicts.

run_dir.description: Existing run beneath artifacts/runs or artifacts/s2/model_lanes/fixtures with regular manifest.json <=1 MiB and pcm.duration_seconds.

windows.description: Non-overlapping windows of 0.25-30 s inside the manifest duration.

limitations: Gateway configured only by VIDEO_UTILS_GUITAR_NOUL_GATEWAY (https, models.xoxd.ai or *.ts.net, port 443); unset -> gateway_not_configured. Gateway is assumed tailnet-only behind tsidp and is not deployed until TIN-5590 serving parity.
Real-take windows leave video-utils only with VIDEO_UTILS_GUITAR_NOUL_ALLOW_REAL_TAKE=v6-private-operator-lab-host (V6); otherwise real_take_not_permitted before any transport.
Wire schema tin-5619-v0 and label vocabulary are unratified; labels are opaque detector hypotheses (is_label false), never annotations, badges or note verdicts.
Invalid gateway items abstain with gateway_response_invalid and keep the raw response sha256; omitted windows abstain missing_from_response; deadline abstains timeout.

dependencies.note: Requires the deployed gateway and, for real takes, the explicit V6 environment switch. No credentials are held by the client.

agent_workflow.identify: Inspect per-window decisions, abstain reasons, model identity and the input signal version.
agent_workflow.research: Read TIN-5619 and the guitar-noul skill; treat the gateway as an external hypothesis source.
agent_workflow.iterate: Compare hypotheses with project phrase/rhythm evidence on the same spans; listen; never map labels to issue badges.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A decision is never a label, a mistake verdict or listening acceptance; vocabulary ratification is an open item.
